title: Lesson Plan — Polynomials (Class 10 CBSE Mathematics)
subject: Mathematics
objectives: Identify a polynomial, state its degree, classify it (linear, quadratic, cubic).
Verify whether a given value is a zero of a polynomial.
Use the discriminant to predict the nature of zeros of a quadratic.
Apply α + β = −b/a, αβ = c/a, plus identities, to compute symmetric expressions in the zeros.
Construct a quadratic given its zeros.
Apply Vieta's relations for a cubic.
Perform polynomial long division and verify the algorithm.
prerequisites: Class 9 idea of polynomials and zeros.
Comfort with substitution and algebraic manipulation.
materials: Cards with polynomials (for 'find the degree' card sort)

activities.description: Hook: 'I'm thinking of a quadratic with sum of zeros 5 and product 6. What is it?' Take guesses; reveal x² − 5x + 6.
Pair work: students sketch y = x² − 5x + 6 by plotting 5 points and identifying the x-axis crossings.
Three blocks: (i) zeros + discriminant + graph; (ii) Vieta's relations for quadratic and cubic; (iii) division algorithm with worked example.
student_actions: Compute α² + β² for example quadratic.

activities.description: Set homework + preview Chapter 3 (Pair of Linear Equations).

homework: Find sum, product, α² + β², 1/α + 1/β for x² − 8x + 12.
Construct quadratics with: (i) zeros 4 and −1, (ii) sum = 0 and product = −9.
Divide x³ − 3x² + 2x − 6 by x − 3; find quotient and remainder.
assessment_ideas: Use the 4-item exit ticket as formative.
Mark the LONG_ANSWER on missing-zero problem (using division) with rubric.
references: NCERT Class 10 Mathematics textbook (jemh1dd), Chapter 2: Polynomials.
